_meta.verified_against: Appendix A Requirements Compliance Matrix pp.102-117 + overview table pp.11-12
notes: This file is the promoted final applicability artifact for Atlas implementation.
Applicability must be driven by explicit path mapping, not by inferred numeric FCR ranges.
FCR 9 is an NFC composite/bonded extension, not an FC requirement.
FCR 21 and FCR 22 attach to fracture-critical parts and NFC composite/bonded parts, not to all NFC metallic paths.
FCR 20 applies only when detected flaws are accepted for flight without repair or replacement.
No NFC or FC downstream requirements attach once exempt classification is valid.
Use for NFC metallic hardware that qualifies under section 6.1 specific hardware paths.
Use for NFC metallic hardware that qualifies under section 6.2 general NFC categories.
Specific NFC hardware path under section 6.1 plus the section 6.3 composite/bonded extension.
General NFC path under section 6.2 plus the section 6.3 composite/bonded extension.
Base FC path for hardware covered by section 7.2 established approaches.
Add metallic/composite NDE and optional flaw-screening subrequirements as conditionals.
General metallic FC path for parts not covered by section 7.2 or approved optional approaches.
General composite/bonded FC path for parts not covered by section 7.2 or approved optional approaches.
Base FC optional path for section 7.5 cases approved by the RFCB.
Add metallic/composite NDE and flaw-screening conditionals based on actual material system and screening method.
Product state only. Not an FCR classification in NASA-STD-5019A.
Conservative fallback should treat the part as fracture-critical pending evidence.

conditional_extensions.name: fc_metallic_nde
conditional_extensions.when: classification is FC and material_system is metallic and NDE is the screening method

conditional_extensions.name: fc_composite_bonded_nde
conditional_extensions.when: classification is FC and material_system is composite or bonded

conditional_extensions.name: proof_test_used
conditional_extensions.when: proof testing is used as the flaw-screening technique

conditional_extensions.name: process_controls_used
conditional_extensions.when: process controls are used to establish flaw-size bounds

conditional_extensions.name: detected_flaw_accepted_for_flight
conditional_extensions.when: hardware with detected flaws is flown without repair or replacement

conditional_extensions.name: nfc_composite_or_bonded_extension
conditional_extensions.when: NFC part uses composite or bonded material system

special_rules.note: KIc/Fty >= 0.33 sqrt(in) belongs here, not under general FCR 22.
Traceability applies to fracture-critical parts and NFC composite/bonded parts.
FCR 22 applies to fracture-critical parts and NFC composite/bonded parts.
